subject.title: [Feature]: Support Anthropic native server-side tools (web_search, web_fetch, code_execution)

question: Should OpenClaw support Anthropic web_fetch and code_execution/PTC with allowed_callers as first-class Anthropic plugin behavior, and what opt-in, billing, permission, and replay policy should govern it?
rationale: The remaining work changes provider-native execution, tool permission, data-access, billing, and transcript replay semantics, so automation should not choose the public API shape or default security policy.

options.title: Design gated Anthropic server tools
options.body: Define an explicit opt-in Anthropic plugin/transport surface for web_search, web_fetch, code_execution/PTC, allowed_callers, and server-result replay before implementation.

options.title: Split narrow trackers
options.body: Let narrower issues cover native web_search and advisor/server-block behavior while creating separate product decisions for web_fetch and code_execution/PTC.

options.title: Defer hosted execution
options.body: Document that OpenClaw will keep client-side fetch/search and existing provider tools for now without Anthropic code_execution/PTC support.

recommendation.title: Design gated Anthropic server tools
recommendation.body: Define an explicit opt-in Anthropic plugin/transport surface for web_search, web_fetch, code_execution/PTC, allowed_callers, and server-result replay before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the freshest visible review context and current-line ownership across the affected Anthropic transport/config/plugin surfaces.
